description: TrainMeUp connects ChatGPT to your TrainMeUp account so you can review recent workouts, active goals and KPIs, your current routine, and mesocycle readiness. It can also draft a routine change proposal for you to confirm in the mobile app. It never invents metrics and does not apply routine changes from ChatGPT.
